title: Total current calculation
description: Essential: The response must correctly compute the total circuit current as 1 A using Ohm's law for the closed circuit.

title: Equivalent resistance derivation
description: Important: The student must correctly combine R2 and R3 in parallel, then add R1 to find the total external resistance of 10 Ω.

title: Electric field strength
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the electric field strength between the plates as 100 V/m using the terminal voltage and plate separation.

title: Terminal voltage application
description: Important: The student must correctly determine the terminal voltage across the plates (10 V) by accounting for the internal resistance voltage drop.

title: Force equilibrium analysis
description: Essential: The response must correctly apply force equilibrium (tanθ = Fe/(mg)) to solve for the mass, yielding 0.004 kg.

title: Electric force identification
description: Important: The student must correctly identify that the electric force on the sphere is E0 * q and relate it to the thread angle.

title: Incorrect parallel resistance
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly treats R2 and R3 as being in series, or mis-handles the parallel combination.

title: Neglecting internal resistance
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses the emf directly to find the plate voltage or electric field, ignoring the internal resistance.

title: Angle or force resolution error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly resolves forces (e.g., uses sin or cos instead of tan in the equilibrium equation).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Award credit if the student explicitly shows unit analysis for the final mass or electric field calculations.
